Definition: a Palluite (collectively) or descendants of Pallu
BiblicalUsage: Pallu'îy is the Palluite, a descendant of Pallu, son of Reuben. In the census of the second generation in the wilderness, the family of the Palluites is counted among the families of Reuben.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the families are counted because the people matter: a clan name in a census is a family God knows.
